headline: Central Maine Power Transmission Corridor Proposal, PUC Docket 2025-00276, with updates on Franklin Street and a Vision Zero median strip ordinance.
summary: The meeting covers the Central Maine Power transmission corridor proposal. It also includes plans for Franklin Street, a Vision Zero update and median strip ordinance, and a grant for a Stroudwater Dam study.
items: Central Maine Power Transmission Corridor Proposal, PUC Docket 2025-00276: presentations from Central Maine Power, the Alliance for Responsible Infrastructure, and the Public Advocate, then committee discussion. No public comment.
Reimaging Franklin Street, presented by Kevin Kraft and Bruce Hyman. Public comment will be taken.
Vision Zero program update and committee discussion of the median strip ordinance, presented by Greg Jordan. No public comment.
Communication regarding a grant to develop an alternatives analysis study for the Stroudwater Dam, presented by Troy Moon. No public comment.
